content: Womu ɡe Asɑfu u kuɑ. Ge wee.

content.text: Nɛn tɔmbu, i nɛn ɡɑri swɑɑ dɑkio.
I swɑɑ tem kpĩiyɔ i nɔ ye nɑ ɡerumɔ.
Kon bɛɛ fɑɑɡi ɡɑɑ kuɑ kɑ mɔnnu ye yɑ sɑ̃ɑ yellun ɡɑri.
Ye sɑ nuɑ kɑ ye sɑ ɡiɑ kɑ ye bɛsɛn bɑɑbɑbɑ bɑ sun sɔ̃ɔwɑ,
sɑ ǹ ye bɛsɛn bibu beruɑmmɛ.
Sɑ ko bu Yinni Gusunɔn tɔmɑru sɔ̃wɑ kɑ win dɑm ɡɑri kɑ sɔm mɑɑmɑɑkiɡii ni u kuɑ.
U bɛsɛ Isirelibɑ, Yɑkɔbun bweseru woodɑ wɛ̃.
Woodɑ yerɑ u bɛsɛn bɑɑbɑbɑ wɛ̃ bu kɑ ye ben bibu sɔ̃ɔsi.
Bii be bɑ koo mɑrurɑ, ben tii bɑ koo ye ɡiɑ,
kpɑ bu mɑɑ ye ben bibu sɔ̃ɔsi.
Sɑɑ yerɑ bɑ koo Yinni Gusunɔ nɑɑnɛ ko.
Bɑ ǹ mɑɑ duɑrimɔ ye u kuɑ.
Kpɑ bu win woodɑbɑ mɛm nɔɔwɑ.
Bɑ ǹ mɑɑ mɔ̀ nɡe ben bɑɑbɑbɑ.
Domi bɑɑbɑ be, bɑ kuɑ mɛm nɔɔ sɑribɑ,
mɑ ben ɡɔ̃ru ɡɑ ǹ kɑ Gusunɔ turo yɔ̃re.
Mɑ bɑ kuɑ nɑɑnɛ sɑribɑ Gusunɔn mi.
Efɑrɑimun bweseru te tɑ tɛnnu mɔ
tɑ biruku yirɑ wurɑ tɑbun sɑɑ.
Tɑ ǹ ten ɑrukɑwɑni yibie ye tɑ kɑ Gusunɔ bɔkuɑ.
Tɑ yinɑ tu win woodɑbɑ mɛm nɔɔwɑ.
Tɑ win sɔm mɑɑmɑɑkiɡii ni duɑri ni u tu sɔ̃ɔsi.
U mɑɑmɑɑki kuɑ ben sikɑdobɑn wuswɑɑɔ Soɑniɔ Eɡibitin temɔ.
U nim wɔ̃ku bɛrɑ ɡɑ kpɑɑsinɑ ɡɑ yɔ̃rɑ nɡe ɡɑnɑ,
mɑ u derɑ bɑ tɔburɑ.
Guru wii wurorɑ u derɑ tɑ bu ɡbiiye sɔ̃ɔ sɔɔ.
Wɔ̃kuru, kpɑ u de dɔ̃ɔ yɑrɑ yɑ n sɔ̃ɔsire ɡuru wii wuro te sɔɔ.
U kpenu bɛsukɑ ɡbɑburɔ,
mɑ nim bɑkɑm mu kurɑ bɑ nɔrɑ.
U derɑ nim mu yɑrɑ kpenun di,
mɑ mu kokumɔ nɡe dɑɑ bɑkɑrun nim.
Adɑmɑ kɑ mɛ, bɑɑbɑ be, bɑ wi, Wɔrukoo torɑrimɔwɑ bɑ dɔɔ.
Bɑ nùn seesiwɑ ɡbɑburu mi, mi ɡɑ̃ɑnu ku rɑ kpi.
Mɑ bɑ wi, Gusunɔ nɔɔ kuurɑ bɑ nùn dĩɑnu kɑnɑ ni bɑ kĩ.
Bɑ nɛɛ, kɑ ɡem, Gusunɔ u koo kpĩ u sun diisiɑ ɡbɑburu mini?
Geemɑ, Mɔwisi u kpee te so, mɑ nim mu kokɑ nɡe dɑɑrun nim.
Adɑmɑ u koo kpĩ u sun diisiɑ?
U koo kpĩ u sun yɑɑ wɛ̃ su tem?
Ye Yinni Gusunɔ u yeni kpuro nuɑ,
yerɑ win mɔru yɑ seewɑ nɡe dɔ̃ɔ
wi bɑ sɔ̃re win tɔmbu Isirelibɑn sɔ̃.
Domi bɑ ǹ nùn nɑɑnɛ kue.
Bɑ ǹ win somiru yĩiyɔ.
Kɑ mɛ, u ɡuru wiru woodɑ wɛ̃.
Mɑ u wɔllun ɡɑmbobɑ kɛniɑ.
U derɑ dĩɑ ni bɑ mɔ̀ mɑnnɑ nu bu nɛɛyɑ sɑɑ wɔllun di.
U bu ye wɛ̃wɑ nɡe mɛ̀n nɔɔ bɑ kĩ.
Tɔn boko dimɑ bɑ di.
Yen biru, u derɑ woo ɡɑ nɑ
sɑɑ sɔ̃ɔ yɑri yerun di ɡɑ wɔllu swee.
Kɑ win dɑmɑ u woo seeyɑmɑ
sɔ̃ɔ yɛ̃sɑn nɔm dwɑru ɡiɑn di,
mɑ u derɑ ɡunɔsu su sɑrɑmɑ
su bu wukiri nɡe tuɑ.
Su dɑbi nɡe yɑni sɛɛri nim wɔ̃kun ɡoorɔ.
U derɑ su wɔrukɑ su tɛrie bɑɑmɑ ben sɑnsɑniɔ.
Mɑ Gusunɔ u bu wɛ̃ ye bɑ kĩ.
Mɑ bɑ di bɑ debɑ.
Adɑmɑ ye bɑ dimɔ bɑ ǹ kpɑ, dĩɑnu yibɑ ben nɔsɔ.
Sɑnɑm mɛyɑ Gusunɔ u kɑ bu mɔru kuɑ.
Mɑ u be bɑ dɑm bo ɡo.
U ben ɑluwɑɑsibɑ so u sururɑ.
Kɑ mɛ, bɑ wure bɑ torɑ.
Bɑ ǹ win sɔm mɑɑmɑɑkiɡii ni nɑɑnɛ kue.
Mɑ Yinni Gusunɔ u bu doke bɛrum sɔɔ u ben wɑ̃ɑru nɔru koosiɑ nɡe woo.
U bu kɑm koosiɑ nɔni kpɑki teeru.
Yinni Gusunɔ ù n kĩ u bu ɡo,
yerɑ ben ɡɑbu bɑ rɑ ɡɔsirɑmɛ win mi ɡiɑ.
Kpɑ bu yɑɑyɑ mɑ wi, Wɔrukoowɑ u sɑ̃ɑ ben kpee bɑɑ mì bɑ rɑ kuke.
Wiyɑ u rɑ mɑɑ bu wɔre.
Adɑmɑ bɑ ku rɑ ɡem ɡere.
Bɑ rɑ n kĩ bu nùn nɔni wɔ̃kewɑ kɑ ben ɡɑri.
Ben ɡɔ̃ru ɡɑ ǹ kɑ nùn wɑ̃ɑ.
Bɑ ǹ mɑɑ ben ɑrukɑwɑni yibie.
Adɑmɑ kɑ mɛ, Yinni Gusunɔ u rɑ tii nɛnɛ
u kun win mɔru kpuro yɔ̃su.
U rɑ bu wɔnwɔndu kue,
kpɑ u bu ben durum wɔkɑ u kun bu ɡo.
U rɑ yɑɑye mɑ bɑ sɑ̃ɑwɑ tɔmbu.
Bɑ sɑ̃ɑwɑ nɡe woo.
Gɑ̀ n doonɑ, ɡɑ ku rɑ wurɑmɛ.
Nɔn dɑbinɑ bɑ Gusunɔ seesi ɡbɑburɔ.
Nɔn dɑbinɑ bɑ win mɔru seeyɑ.
Bɑ mɑɑ wure bɑ nùn nɔɔ kuurɑ wi, wi u sɑ̃ɑ ben Yinni Dɛɛro.
Bɑ ǹ tɔ̃ɔ te yɑɑye tè sɔɔ u bu wɔrɑ yibɛrɛbɑn nɔmɑn di kɑ win dɑm.
Bɑ ǹ mɑɑ yɑɑye sɔm mɑɑmɑɑkiɡii ni u kuɑ Eɡibitiɔ kɑ Soɑnin ɡberu kpɑɑnɛɔ.
U Eɡibitiɡibun dɑɑnun nim ɡɔsiɑ yɛm,
mɑ bɑ kpɑnɑ bu mu nɔ.
U derɑ ɡbɑbu swɛ̃ɛ yi bu wɔri yi di.
Mɑ u derɑ surenu nu bu kɑm kuɑ.
U derɑ twee yi ben dĩɑnu wɔri yi di.
Mɑ u derɑ ben hɑniɑn ɑre kɑm kuɑ.
U derɑ ɡuru kpenu nu ben resɛm ɡbɑɑnu kɑm koosiɑ.
Mɑ woorɑ ben dɑ̃ɑ ɡbɑɑnu sɑnkɑ.
U derɑ ɡuru ɡbɑ̃ɑ kɑ ɡuru kpenu ben yɑɑ sɑbenu di.
Mɑ u kɑ Eɡibitiɡii be mɔru seewɑ kɑ dɑm u bu nɔni sɔ̃ɔwɑ.
U derɑ ɡɔɔn ɡɔrɑdobɑ bɑ nɑ dɑbi dɑbinu bɑ bu wɔri.
U ǹ dere win mɔru yu ɡoo sɛ̃ɛnɑ.
U bu kɛ̃si kɛ̃si bɑrɑnu kpɛ̃ɛ u kɑ bu ɡo.
U Eɡibitiɡibu be, be bɑ sɑ̃ɑ Kɑmun bibun bweserun bii tɔn durɔ ɡbiikoo bɑɑwure ɡo,
be, be bɑ sɑ̃ɑ ben ɑluwɑɑsirun bibu.
U derɑ win tɔmbɑ yɑrɑ nɡe yɑ̃ɑ ɡɔ̃ɔ ɡe ɡɑ yɑrimɑ ɡɔ̃run di.
Mɑ u bu kpɑrɑ ɡbɑburɔ.
U bu kpɑrɑ kɑ bɔri yɛndu, bɑ ǹ diirɑ.
Mɑ u derɑ nim wɔ̃ku ɡɑ ben yibɛrɛbɑ wukiri.
Mɑ u kɑ bu dɑ win tem dɛɛrɑmɔ,
ɡuu ten mi, te u mwɑ kɑ win dɑm.
U bwese tukunu ɡirɑ win tɔmbu Isirelibɑn sɔ̃.
Mɑ u tem mɛ bɔnu kuɑ u derɑ bɑ sinɑ mi, kuu bekuruɡinu sɔɔ.
Adɑmɑ bɑ Gusunɔ nɔɔ kuurɑ.
Bɑ wi, Wɔrukoo seesi.
Bɑ ǹ win woodɑbɑ mɛm nɔɔwɛ.
Bɑ Gusunɔ dɛsirɑri, mɑ bɑ kuɑ nɑɑnɛ sɑribɑ
nɡe mɛ ben bɑɑbɑbɑ bɑ rɑɑ kuɑ.
Bɑ wururɑ nɡe tɛn tèn kirikɑ yɑ kusirɑ.
Bɑ win mɔru seeyɑ kɑ ben bũu turɑnu.
Bɑ win nisinu seeyɑ kɑ ben bwɑ̃ɑrokunu.
Ye Gusunɔ u ye kpuro wɑ, yerɑ win mɔru seewɑ,
mɑ u Isirelibɑ yinɑ.
U sɑ̃ɑ yee te deri te tɑ wɑ̃ɑ Siloɔ.
U kuu bekuruɡii te deri tèn mi u rɑ kɑ bu yinnɛ.
Mɑ u derɑ yibɛrɛbɑ bɑ win woodɑn kpɑkororu mwɑ,
tè sɔɔ u rɑ win dɑm kɑ win yiiko sɔ̃ɔsi.
U derɑ bɑ kɑ tu doonɑ tem tukumɔ.
U kɑ win tɔmbu mɔru kuɑ,
mɑ u derɑ bɑ bu ɡo tɑbu sɔɔ.
U derɑ ɑluwɑɑsibɑ bɑ dɔ̃ɔ mwɑɑrɑ,
mɑ wɔndiɑbɑ bɑ durɔbu biɑ.
U derɑ bɑ ben yɑ̃ku kowobu ɡo tɑbu sɔɔ kɑ tɑkobi.
Mɑ ben ɡɔminibu bɑ ǹ ben ɡɔɔ swĩ.
Yerɑ Yinni Gusunɔ u seewɑ nɡe tɔnu wi u dom yɑndɑmɑ.
U seewɑ nɡe tɑbu durɔ wɔruɡɔ wi tɑm mu ɡoomɔ.
Mɑ u win yibɛrɛbɑ so u ɡirɑ.
U bu sekuru doke te tɑ ǹ kpeemɔ sere kɑ bɑɑdommɑɔ.
U Efɑrɑimu Yosɛfun biin bweseru yinɑ.
U ǹ tu ɡɔsɑ.
Yudɑn bweseru kɑ Siɔnin ɡuurɑ u kĩɑ u ɡɔsɑ.
Guuru miyɑ u win sɑ̃ɑ yeru bɑnɑ
tɑ dɑm mɔ nɡe wɔllu kɑ tem
mɛ u swĩi sere kɑ bɑɑdommɑɔ.
U Dɑfidi ɡɔsɑ u n kɑ sɑ̃ɑ win sɔm kowo.
Yɑ̃ɑ kpɑrɑ yerun diyɑ u nùn mwɑɑmɑ
u kɑ ko Isirelibɑ, Yɑkɔbun bweserun kpɑro
be, be bɑ sɑ̃ɑ wi, Yinni Gusunɔn tɔmbu.
Dɑfidi wi, u tɔn be kpɑrɑwɑ kɑ ɡɔ̃ru dɛɛrɔ, kɑ lɑɑkɑri.
